subject: Medford High School Designs and Zoning Updates
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed attorney Nick Giurleo regarding six design options for the Medford High School project and recent zoning changes in Medford Square. Giurleo also discussed his appointment to the new Neighborhood Ambassador Program.

items.title: Medford High School project design review
items.summary: Nick Giurleo detailed six design options for the Medford High School project, ranging from a code-only upgrade to full new construction with estimated costs up to $893 million.

items.title: Medford Square zoning district
items.summary: The interview covered the new Medford Square zoning district, which allows for increased density through sub-districts permitting buildings of four to eight stories.

items.title: Transom project and zoning overlay
items.summary: Giurleo discussed the Transom housing project and its associated zoning overlay, noting concerns regarding potential spot zoning and the reduction of community discretion in the approval process.

items.title: Neighborhood Ambassador Program
items.summary: Giurleo outlined the Neighborhood Ambassador Program, which utilizes volunteer representatives to facilitate communication between residents and the city administration.
